new_learnings.text: MA-distance filter eliminated 27/33 enriched candidates today (82%). This is the single most important gate in the system — without it, we would have bought 联瑞新材 (+43.8% above MA20), 帝尔激光 (+58.2%), and multiple other extreme-chase setups. The stocks it blocked are all visually 'strong' but mathematically overextended.
new_learnings.mechanism: Mean-reversion risk dominates when price is >12% above MA20 regardless of sector strength. The pullback probability is asymmetrically high.

new_learnings.text: RPS20/RPS120 divergence is a timing signal, not a hard skip. 华锡有色 RPS120 91% (strong medium-term) vs RPS20 11% (terrible short-term) in a hot sector (#4 小金属). This pattern often resolves with the stock catching up to its sector. Size small (3% vs normal 6%) to account for the uncertainty.
new_learnings.mechanism: Sector gravity eventually pulls lagging members up, but the timing is unpredictable. Small sizing lets you participate without over-committing to a potential continued lag.

new_learnings.text: 0-risk candidates are exceptionally rare (1/33 enriched today) and deserve priority when they also pass RPS + MA filters. 睿创微纳 is the only 0-risk stock among all candidates. The V1 data showed 0-risk stocks outperform — this is a strong signal when combined with technical compliance.
new_learnings.mechanism: Zero risk flags = no known negative catalysts, no技术面 warning signs, no 估值 alerts. These stocks have cleaner price action and fewer reasons for sudden selloffs.

new_learnings.text: Fresh M&A catalysts that haven't yet moved price create ideal entry windows. 恩捷股份 announced SKIET acquisition on 5/27, yet the stock is pulling back to MA20 (dist_ma20 -0.8%) and '过去10天价格涨幅仅高于6%'. The market has not priced in this catalyst yet — this is the sweet spot between news breaking and price responding.
new_learnings.mechanism: Market inefficiency: significant corporate events take 2-5 days to be fully priced when they occur outside of earnings season. The pullback to MA20 support during this window provides a low-risk entry.

new_learnings.text: Breadth at 1.28:1 with distribution skewed to r0_2 (small gains) is a 'mild rally' — not ideal for aggressive entries. Appropriate response is 3 small positions at 12% total, keeping 88% cash. This is consistent with the learning that strong breadth alone doesn't force entries (h013).
new_learnings.mechanism: When most up stocks are barely positive (r0_2 dominates), the marginal buyer is weak. Aggressive entries in this environment have higher failure rates.
